requirements.statement: Bind entry to PR 13 head, squash commit, tree, parent, exact-head CI, immutable artifact, artifact digests, and post-merge main CI.
Byte-verify protected Stage 4 authorities and preserve every frozen v1 and accepted v2 schema.
Pass the complete Stage 4 validator before and after Stage 5 implementation.
Preserve every current-bundle admitted occurrence without changing the existing new-effect and unique-observation views.
Distinguish same-manifest bank duplication from identical prior-state replay.
Merge immutable prior settlement state by source identity and reject changed-content reuse before returning candidates.
Make bank-first, settlement-first, and replayed arrival converge without double business effect.
Use exactly processor, merchant_id, settlement_id, settlement_cycle, and currency as the settlement grain.
Evaluate the full outer union of processor-settlement and settlement-journal keys while preventing bank-only records from inventing keys.
Recompute gross minus fee, refund, chargeback, and reserve with checked signed 64-bit subtraction for every processor record.
Detect reported-net mismatch per processor record before aggregation so offsetting errors cannot cancel.
Aggregate each unique processor settlement once and preserve processor settlement count.
Calculate settlement ledger movement only from PROCESSOR_CLEARING credits minus debits.
Never substitute total journal debits, credits, or counterpart postings for clearing movement.
Classify an invalid clearing-posting count as INVALID_ACCOUNT_ROLE while retaining diagnostic movement and journal count.
Index settlement targets by merchant, currency, and the NFC-normalized outer-trimmed settlement identifier.
Allocate a bank identity only when its exact case- and punctuation-sensitive reference selects one target.
Reject any current or cross-state reference with multiple settlement targets before returning state or candidates.
Forbid amount, date, arrival order, or proximity matching and allocate every bank identity at most once.
Allow multiple distinct bank identities to aggregate one settlement and apply credit-positive, debit-negative signs.
Give every unique bank identity exactly one deterministic allocated or unallocated disposition.
Keep missing and unknown references visible as UNALLOCATED_BANK_MOVEMENT without adding them to candidate bank totals.
Count a same-manifest duplicate once and emit DUPLICATE_BANK_MOVEMENT, while prior replay remains idempotent.
Associate exact-reference cash from a disallowed account diagnostically and force INVALID_BANK_ACCOUNT.
Preserve processor-ledger, processor-bank, and ledger-bank signed deltas independently.
Define difference as the checked maximum absolute value of the three pairwise deltas.
Preserve processor, journal, and allocated-bank counts so missing evidence cannot collapse into genuine zero.
Allow absent ledger and bank evidence only for a genuine zero processor net with no semantic error.
Apply tolerance only after semantic validation and emit exact deterministic reason precedence.
Return immutable candidates, allocations, and settlement state with canonical deterministic digests.
Publish no partial result after rejection and never claim or persist an authoritative proof.
Keep production independent from the reference oracle, Spark, persistence, network, AWS, and infrastructure clients.
Expose a read-only local command whose success and rejection outputs preserve the Stage 5 claim boundary.
Pass the full suite, 100 percent Stage 5 statement and branch coverage, all semantic mutations, wheel installation, and two clean Python 3.11.13 runs.
Require exact-head draft-PR CI, immutable evidence inspection, squash merge, and independent main CI before Stage 5 promotion.
